meta.title: Implement maxAge fast scraping parameter
meta.body_summary: Implement maxAge parameter to expose Firecrawl API caching for faster scraping, with test coverage and tool description updates.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added maxAge MCP server parameter and test; merged instantly without review; narrative 500% claim unverified.
